Hi Angela —

Appreciate the follow-up. Below is the operational plan we recommend for the ND-2027-ENT-049 committed spend:

1) Invoice cadence
   - Annual committed amount will be invoiced as an upfront annual invoice on 2027-01-15 (Invoice #RWI-ND-2027-01).
   - After the upfront invoice, we will issue a short monthly statement on the 1st of each month that shows: opening prepay balance, monthly consumption (token/embedding units), monthly withdrawal amount, and closing balance. Statements are informational; the upfront invoice funds the prepaid balance.

2) Monthly withdrawal mechanics
   - Our platform debits consumption against the prepaid balance daily; accounting-visible "withdrawals" are netted and summarized on the 1st monthly statement as a single line: "Monthly Consumption Withdrawal".
   - On your ledger this appears as: 
     * Debit: Prepaid Inference Credits (asset reduction)
     * Credit: Redwood Revenue (income recognition for consumed portion)
   - If monthly consumption exceeds a threshold we agreed for the tier, a top-up invoice will be issued (rare for committed tiers).

3) VAT and invoice lines
   - For US-registered Nimbus entities: Redwood will not charge VAT on the primary invoice (US sales). For EU subsidiaries you provided, we will issue intra-company invoice lines with VAT as required by local rules if billing is routed to an EU legal entity.
   - Invoice line example (upfront invoice):
     * Line 1: Annual Committed Prepay — Redwood Inference Platform (USD) — Quantity: 1 — Amount: $360,000
     * Line 2: VAT (if EU billing) — Rate: X% (country-specific) — Amount: computed per entity
   - We will include VAT registration numbers and the breakdown by billed legal entity to support reclaim.

4) Documents & next steps
   - I will send an invoice stub for 2027-01-15 and a signed PO acceptance after we confirm billing entities and VAT routing.
   - cc: Lauren (billing), Ben (customer success) to confirm GL mapping and cadence.

Please confirm the billing legal entity for the contract (US HQ or one of the EU subsidiaries). If US HQ, VAT is not charged; if an EU entity will be billed, please provide the VAT number for that entity.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
